context_patterns: complaints filed under the sexual harassment of women at workplace

context_patterns: details of total energy consumption and energy intensity
families.notes: DELIBERATELY GENERIC (same pattern as posh_and_shw_act_metrics): this context covers 9 distinct metrics (electricity/fuel/other-source consumption x renewable/non-renewable, plus 2 subtotals, plus grand total, plus intensity ratios) sharing the same 2-value (current FY, previous FY) shape. Actual metric identity preserved in MappedRow.row.label. KNOWN GAP: SEBI spec defines cross-row arithmetic relationships here (A+B+C=renewable total, D+E+F=non-renewable total, all summed=grand total) that this schema cannot check — validation_rules only operate within a single row's fields, not across rows. Deferred to a future cross-row validation layer. Verified real Glenmark data: 'Total electricity consumption (A)' -> [46,951, 16,602], 'Total electricity consumption (D)' -> [3,71,005, 3,77,263].
canonical_phrases: Details of total energy consumption and energy intensity

context_patterns: provide details of the following disclosures related to water
families.notes: DELIBERATELY GENERIC (same pattern as energy_consumption/posh): covers ~9 distinct water metrics (withdrawal by 5 sources, total withdrawal, total consumption, 2 intensity ratios) sharing the same 2-value shape. Metric identity preserved in MappedRow.row.label. Verified real Glenmark data: 'Total volume of water withdrawal...' -> [5,46,033, 5,29,632]. Company-wide scope — distinct from water_stress_area_disclosures (a different, narrower question).
canonical_phrases: Provide details of the following disclosures related to water

context_patterns: water withdrawal, consumption and discharge in areas of water stress
families.notes: Leadership Indicator, narrower scope than water_disclosures — only facilities located in identified water-stress areas, not company-wide. Verified real Glenmark data (page 37): 'Total volume of water withdrawal...' -> [1,04,684, 1,02,606] — DIFFERENT number from the company-wide figure despite an almost-identical row label, confirming these must stay separate families.
canonical_phrases: Water withdrawal, consumption and discharge in areas of water stress

context_patterns: provide details related to waste management by the entity
families.notes: DELIBERATELY GENERIC (same pattern as energy/water): covers ~8 waste categories (plastic, e-waste, bio-medical, construction, battery, hazardous, non-hazardous, total) plus recovery/disposal breakdowns, all 2-value shape. Metric identity in MappedRow.row.label. Verified real Glenmark data: 'Total Waste Generated (A+B+...+H)' -> [4,060, 3,808].
canonical_phrases: Provide details related to waste management by the entity

context_patterns: provide details of greenhouse gas emissions.*and its intensity
families.notes: DELIBERATELY GENERIC: covers Scope 1, Scope 2 emissions, and 4 intensity ratios, all 2-value shape. Note: many rows here have an EMPTY label (source paragraph is just raw numbers, no leading label text) — this is normal, not a bug (also seen in union_membership). Verified real Glenmark data: Scope 1 emissions -> [11,797, 17,263].
canonical_phrases: Provide details of greenhouse gas emissions, Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions, and its intensity

context_patterns: please provide details of air emissions
families.notes: DELIBERATELY GENERIC: covers NOx, SOx, Particulate Matter, POP, VOC, HAP, and other air pollutants, all 2-value shape. Distinct from ghg_emissions (Q7, a separate SEBI question — GHG is Scope 1/2 CO2-equivalent, this is other pollutants). Verified real Glenmark data: NOx -> [118, 120].
canonical_phrases: Please provide details of air emissions other than GHG emissions by the entity

context_patterns: please provide details of air emissions
families.notes: 3-value variant of air_emissions: when a pollutant's unit column is blank, the source renders it as a literal '-', which our NA_TOKENS treats as a value token, producing 3 raw values instead of 2. Verified real data (both companies): 'Persistent organic pollutants (POP)' -> ['-', 'N/A', 'N/A'].
canonical_phrases: Please provide details of air emissions other than GHG emissions by the entity

context_patterns: provide details related to waste management by the entity
families.notes: 3-value variant of waste_management — same root cause as air_emissions_with_blank_unit. Verified real Aequs data: 'Radioactive waste (F)' -> ['-', '0.00', '0.00'].
canonical_phrases: Provide details related to waste management by the entity

canonical_phrases: Percentage of R&D and capital expenditure investments in specific technologies
